name: @grasdouble/kitia
description: Kitia — Your AI toolkit, in good hands.

scripts.build: pnpm run cli:build && pnpm run web:build
scripts.test: pnpm run docs:test && pnpm run typecheck:strict && pnpm run cli:test && pnpm run web:test:components
scripts.cli:test: pnpm run cli:build && node --test cli/test/source-catalogs.test.js cli/test/source-highlighting.test.js cli/test/dashboard-filters.test.js cli/test/source-history.test.js cli/test/version-check.test.js cli/test/catalog-freshness.test.js cli/test/action-retry.test.js cli/test/collections.test.js cli/test/migrations.test.js cli/test/audit.test.js cli/test/catalog-render.test.js cli/test/license.test.js
scripts.cli:test:contract: pnpm run cli:build && node --test cli/test/source-catalogs.test.js cli/test/source-history.test.js
scripts.cli:validate: pnpm run cli:build && node cli/bin/kitia.js validate
scripts.web:test:components: node --conditions=development --test web/src/analytics.test.mjs web/src/HomePage.test.mjs web/src/sectionScrolling.test.mjs web/src/components/core/Header.test.mjs web/src/components/sections/Changelog.test.mjs web/src/components/demo/tuiDemoSession.test.mjs web/test/website-screenshots.test.mjs
scripts.web:test:termless: node web/scripts/screenshots-generator/termless-preflight.js && pnpm run cli:build && node --test web/test/termless-dashboard.test.mjs
